#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MAXS = 100000 + 10;
const int MOD = 1000000007;
using ull = unsigned long long;

int n, cnt = 0;
int nxtState[MAXS][64];
int prob[10][10];
int transProb[10][64];
int dp[10][MAXS];
map<ull,int> mp;

int modPow(int a,int b) {
    int res = 1;
    while(b) {
        if(b & 1) res = 1LL * res * a % MOD;
        a = 1LL * a * a % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int construct(ull s) {
    auto it = mp.find(s);
    if(it != mp.end()) return it->second;
    int cur = ++cnt;
    mp[s] = cur;
    int M = 1 << n;
    for(int mask = 0; mask < M; ++mask) {
        ull ns = s;
        for(int j = 0; j < M; ++j) {
            for(int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                if( ((j >> k) & 1) && ((mask >> k) & 1) && ((s >> (j ^ (1 << k))) & 1) ) {
                    ns |= (1ull << j);
                }
            }
        }
        nxtState[cur][mask] = construct(ns);
    }
    return cur;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> n;
    construct(1);

    for(int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for(int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> prob[i][j];
            prob[i][j] = 1LL * prob[i][j] * modPow(100, MOD - 2) % MOD;
        }
    }

    for(int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for(int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            transProb[i][mask] = 1;
            for(int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                if((mask >> k) & 1)
                    transProb[i][mask] = 1LL * transProb[i][mask] * prob[k][i] % MOD;
                else
                    transProb[i][mask] = 1LL * transProb[i][mask] * (MOD + 1 - prob[k][i]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    dp[0][1] = 1;
    for(int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for(int j = 1; j <= cnt; ++j) {
            for(int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
                int to = nxtState[j][mask];
                dp[i + 1][to] = (dp[i + 1][to] + 1LL * dp[i][j] * transProb[i][mask]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    if(n < 6)
        cout << dp[n][mp[(1ull << (1 << n)) - 1]] << '\n';
    else
        cout << dp[n][mp[ULLONG_MAX]] << '\n';

    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;
using ull = unsigned long long;

int n;
int p[10][10];
int q[10][64];

int qpow(int a,int b) {
    int res = 1;
    while(b) {
        if(b & 1) res = 1LL * res * a % MOD;
        a = 1LL * a * a % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

ull transition(ull s,int mask) {
    ull t = s;
    int M = 1 << n;
    for(int j = 0; j < M; ++j)
        for(int k = 0; k < n; ++k)
            if(((j >> k) & 1) && ((mask >> k) & 1) && ((s >> (j ^ (1 << k))) & 1))
                t |= (1ull << j);
    return t;
}

void addTo(map<ull,int>& mp, ull state, int val) {
    if(val == 0) return;
    auto it = mp.find(state);
    if(it == mp.end()) {
        mp.emplace(state, val);
    } else {
        it->second += val;
        if(it->second >= MOD) it->second -= MOD;
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> n;

    for(int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for(int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> p[i][j];
            p[i][j] = 1LL * p[i][j] * qpow(100, MOD - 2) % MOD;
        }

    for(int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for(int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            q[i][mask] = 1;
            for(int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                if((mask >> k) & 1)
                    q[i][mask] = 1LL * q[i][mask] * p[k][i] % MOD;
                else
                    q[i][mask] = 1LL * q[i][mask] * (MOD + 1 - p[k][i]) % MOD;
            }
        }

    map<ull,int> cur, nxt;
    cur[1] = 1;
    int M = 1 << n;

    for(int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        nxt.clear();
        for(const auto &pr : cur) {
            ull s = pr.first;
            int val = pr.second;
            for(int mask = 0; mask < M; ++mask) {
                int delta = 1LL * val * q[i][mask] % MOD;
                if(delta) addTo(nxt, transition(s, mask), delta);
            }
        }
        cur.swap(nxt);
    }

    ull target;
    if(n < 6) target = (1ull << (1 << n)) - 1;
    else target = numeric_limits<ull>::max();

    auto it = cur.find(target);
    cout << (it == cur.end() ? 0 : it->second) << '\n';

    return 0;
}
